name: Falling Meteor
description: A blazing meteor streaks down on a fiery trail and detonates on the ground, over and over
preview_html:
<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><style>*{margin:0;padding:0}body{overflow:hidden}canvas{display:block}</style></head><body><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js"></script><script>(function(){
var W=innerWidth,H=innerHeight;
var renderer=new THREE.WebGLRenderer({antialias:true});
renderer.setSize(W,H);renderer.setClearColor(0x0c0603);
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);
var scene=new THREE.Scene();
var camera=new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(55,W/H,0.1,100);
camera.position.set(0.4,1.6,6);camera.lookAt(0,1.1,0);
function ADD(m){scene.add(m);return m;}
function GLOW(c,o){return new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:c,transparent:true,opacity:o,blending:THREE.AdditiveBlending,depthWrite:false});}
function PTS(n,size,extra){var p=new Float32Array(n*3),c=new Float32Array(n*3),g=new THREE.BufferGeometry();g.setAttribute('position',new THREE.BufferAttribute(p,3));g.setAttribute('color',new THREE.BufferAttribute(c,3));var m=new THREE.PointsMaterial(Object.assign({size:size,vertexColors:true,transparent:true,opacity:0.9,blending:THREE.AdditiveBlending,depthWrite:false},extra||{}));ADD(new THREE.Points(g,m));return {p:p,c:c,g:g,m:m};}
window.addEventListener('resize',function(){W=innerWidth;H=innerHeight;renderer.setSize(W,H);camera.aspect=W/H;camera.updateProjectionMatrix();});

var s0=[2.8,5.6,-0.8],s1=[0,0.16,0];
var met=ADD(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.2,16,16),GLOW(0xffe6b0,1)));
var mg=ADD(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.4,16,16),GLOW(0xff5a1e,0.4)));
var TN=110,T=PTS(TN,0.15),tl=new Float32Array(TN),tk=0;
var IN=80,I=PTS(IN,0.15),iv=new Float32Array(IN*3),il=new Float32Array(IN);
var flash=ADD(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.3,16,16),GLOW(0xffd390,0)));flash.position.set(0,0.16,0);
var ring=ADD(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.5,0.05,8,50),GLOW(0xff7a30,0)));ring.rotation.x=Math.PI/2;ring.position.y=0.08;
var t=0,cy=0,imp=0;
function animate(){requestAnimationFrame(animate);t+=0.02;cy+=0.0085;
  if(cy>=1){cy=0;imp=1;for(var i=0;i<IN;i++){var a=Math.random()*6.283,e=Math.random()*1.3,s=0.05+Math.random()*0.09;iv[i*3]=Math.cos(a)*Math.cos(e)*s;iv[i*3+1]=Math.sin(e)*s+0.05;iv[i*3+2]=Math.sin(a)*Math.cos(e)*s;I.p[i*3]=0;I.p[i*3+1]=0.16;I.p[i*3+2]=0;il[i]=1;}}
  var e=cy*cy;met.position.set(s0[0]+(s1[0]-s0[0])*e,s0[1]+(s1[1]-s0[1])*e,s0[2]+(s1[2]-s0[2])*e);mg.position.copy(met.position);mg.scale.setScalar(1+0.22*Math.sin(t*22));
  for(var k=0;k<3;k++){var j=tk%TN;tk++;T.p[j*3]=met.position.x+(Math.random()-0.5)*0.14;T.p[j*3+1]=met.position.y+(Math.random()-0.5)*0.14;T.p[j*3+2]=met.position.z+(Math.random()-0.5)*0.14;tl[j]=1;}
  for(var i=0;i<TN;i++){if(tl[i]>0)tl[i]-=0.028;var f=Math.max(0,tl[i]);T.c[i*3]=f;T.c[i*3+1]=f*0.42;T.c[i*3+2]=f*0.08;}
  T.g.attributes.position.needsUpdate=true;T.g.attributes.color.needsUpdate=true;
  if(imp>0){imp-=0.02;for(var i=0;i<IN;i++){if(il[i]>0){il[i]-=0.028;iv[i*3+1]-=0.004;I.p[i*3]+=iv[i*3];I.p[i*3+1]+=iv[i*3+1];I.p[i*3+2]+=iv[i*3+2];var f=Math.max(0,il[i]);I.c[i*3]=f;I.c[i*3+1]=f*0.55;I.c[i*3+2]=f*0.12;}}
    I.g.attributes.position.needsUpdate=true;I.g.attributes.color.needsUpdate=true;
    flash.material.opacity=Math.max(0,imp)*0.9;flash.scale.setScalar(1+(1-imp)*3);ring.material.opacity=Math.max(0,imp)*0.8;ring.scale.setScalar(0.3+(1-imp)*3.5);}
  renderer.render(scene,camera);}
animate();})();</script></body></html>
